translationRepairs: Grand Mentor Zhangsun Wuji and others assisted in government; the realm saw no loss of virtue.
Grand Commandant Zhangsun Wuji and others assisted in government; the realm saw no loss of virtue.
Chinese 太尉 is the office taiwei (Grand Commandant); Grand Mentor would be 太傅 (taifu). The proposed replacement correctly restores the title while leaving the rest of the sentence unchanged.
